title: Henri Julien, the watchmaker's house on the Rokin
why: 2019 Rokin front: narrow 5-storey brick house, bell gable, two-storey shopfront with festoons and cartouches, Gapersteeg on the right

title: Café De la Paix, where the COC began (Leidsestraat 67)
